### Ultrasonic Reference Block Study {#sec-pmd-63}

[**Non-Linear Fit with Non-Homogeneous Variances**]{#sec-pmd-63-overview}

This example illustrates the construction of a non-linear regression model for ultrasonic calibration data. This case study demonstrates fitting a non-linear model and the use of transformations and weighted fits to deal with the violation of the assumption of [constant standard deviations](#sec-pmd-213) for the errors. This assumption is also called homogeneous variances for the errors.
